about: CurseForge Media tab entries, in upload order. Images live in docs/img-barn/ (the cat-* shots, also used by the README). Paste label into Title and description into Description. Entries whose file is missing still need a screenshot.

entries.label: Buy
entries.description: A fresh filter layout built around finding better gear fast: pick a slot, toggle Better or Picks, and see upgrades for your class with how much each one gains.

entries.label: Scanning
entries.description: One full scan reads the whole auction house. Coins spill from the progress bar while it works.

entries.label: Sell
entries.description: See at a glance how competitive your price is: your auction slotted into the ladder of current listings, with price rules and how sure the going rate is.

entries.label: Resell
entries.description: Small markets you could buy out and relist at a profit.

entries.label: Graphs
entries.description: Usual and lowest price as lines, units for sale as bars, over 3 to 30 days.

entries.label: Ledger
entries.description: Every auction house trade your character makes, and what each item has made you.

entries.label: Progress and Hero Coins
entries.description: Scan confidence, your daily scan streak, and Hero Coins earned by using the addon.

entries.label: Tooltips
entries.description: Going rate, lowest price and supply on any item; crafted price, material cost and margin on recipes.
